texts: Acme Corp — Jordan Lee, CFO — 14 October FY26
Enterprise renewals and the EMEA launch drove the beat; NRR held at 118%.
Support automation and infra renegotiation offset the FX headwind.
Approve the EMEA headcount plan and the FY27 pricing change (slide 7).
Third consecutive quarter above plan; guidance raised for Q4.
Every metric carries a period-over-period delta — replace all four cards with this quarter’s headline numbers.
EMEA contributed 12pp of the 18pp beat. The gap to plan widened every month of the quarter.
Driver: multi-year renewals. Action: extend the renewal playbook to mid-market.
Driver: pricing change. Action: hold discounting at the 8% ceiling.
Driver: self-serve funnel. Action: decision on paid acquisition in Q4.
12 quota-carrying hires in H1; payback modeled at 14 months.
Move the SMB tier to usage-based pricing; grandfather current contracts.
Extends the margin gain by an estimated 0.8pp in FY27.
Q4 guidance raised to $88-90M on EMEA momentum.
Watch item: CAC payback trend in SMB — review at the January board.
Decisions logged today circulate within 48 hours with owners and dates.
Prepared by Finance — data as of 30 September
